episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Life is perfect for Evie and Pete, who've just moved to a stunning new house. But Pete's worried that Evie gets on a little too well with their neighbour Danny.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: On a day trip to the coast, the chemistry between Evie and Danny is electric, much to the amusement of Becka and to Pete's horror. Evie can't get the tantalising idea of partner swapping out of her head. Desperate for money, Danny gets drawn further into illegal operations, but a routine job takes a horrifying turn. Elsewhere, Alan's obsession with Becka grows after he violates her privacy even further..

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The sexual tension between the two couples reaches boiling point during a weekend away. Alan's obsession with Becka escalates with devastating consequences.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Pete struggles to process what happened on the spa weekend. Evie is determined to conceal her secret. Danny is given an ultimatum.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: An ultimatum from Pete only serves to deepen Evie's obsession with Danny

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Secrets spill out during a violent showdown. Will anyone's relationship survive?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Leo's return sparks a change in Charlotte, and Mia seizes the opportunity to work her way into Jacob and Charlotte's confidence, their street, and eventually their bed, befriending cul-de-sac outcast Alan along the way.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Mia encourages Charlotte and Jacob to reconnect sexually, but it's soon clear that she's manipulating the couple to get exactly what she wants...

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Charlotte and Jacob's romantic anniversary trip to Antwerp takes an erotic but dangerous turn when a third person unexpectedly arrives. Meanwhile, an investigation is launched at the hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jacob and Charlotte navigate how to move forward after their night with Mia, but will what happened in Antwerp stay in Antwerp? Leo and Charlotte reconnect, and the hospital investigation heats up.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jacob comes to a heartbreaking realisation about Charlotte. Another suspicious death rocks the hospital. And when Mia's past comes back to haunt her, Charlotte's left feeling betrayed.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Charlotte and Jacob's marriage implodes and Alan takes drastic action in an attempt to save Mia. Meanwhile, Gemma and Leo race against time to uncover the truth.
